opis: Wynik, liczba lub zmiana pojawia się na kolorowej karcie na tle Twojej marki. Etykieta u góry, duży wynik pośrodku, kontekst pod spodem.
najlepsze_do: Podanie rezultatu, statystyki, przychodu, zasięgu, liczby klientów

przepis.opis_efektu: A result card overlays the lower portion of the frame (bottom 30–35%, y=65–100%). Card background: use the brand canvas color from moj-brand.json plotno field (first color in the array); if not set, use warm cream (#FDE68A). Card structure from top to bottom: (1) small all-caps label in letter-spaced muted text (e.g. 'WYNIK', 'ZASIĘG', 'SPRZEDAŻ'), (2) the main result in very large bold weight — number, percentage or short phrase, fills 50% of card height, (3) one line of context text below in smaller regular weight. Animation: card slides up from the bottom (y from 110% to 0%, spring ease, 400ms). The result number counts up from 0 if it's a number (600ms count-up animation). Card holds for 3–4 seconds, then slides back down. Never covers the face — face must be visible in the upper 60% of frame.
